C232.notes: SER AS-VN-002. Photo confirmed · user shorthand 1000. Emblem side star · cog · rice wreath · CỘNG HÒA XÃ HỘI CHỦ NGHĨA VIỆT NAM · 2003 (value 1000 ĐỒNG on reverse — Joseph). Everyday millennial VND — xe om / café / market odd-change. Country #39 — first Vietnam / first mainland SE Asia (after Hong Kong C146 / Taiwan C200 / Japan C206 East Asia lane). SER sibling: AS-VN-001 (1953 State 20 Su). Vietnam flips now 2.

open_questions: Type catalogued KM#71 for Vietnam 1000 dong 2003, but uCoin, hobbyofkings and others list the circulation 1000 dong 2003 as KM#72. References also describe a One Pillar Pagoda reverse that the design note omits. Verify.

C258.notes: SER AS-VN-001. Photo confirmed · user shorthand 1953. Reverse three rice stalks tied with ribbon · VIET-NAM · 20 SU (three-dragon obverse / date not shown — Joseph dated 1953). State of Vietnam aluminum small change — Bảo Đại / early Ngô Đình Diệm years, before the Republic of Vietnam name stuck and long before reunification. Same national rice motif thread as modern SRV C232 / AS-VN-002 (2003 1000đ wreath) but a different chapter: French-Union / Cold War Saigon pocket money for market rice and cyclo fares. Second Vietnam flip; not a new country (#39 already). Vietnam flips now 2.

open_questions: Type catalogued KM#1 for South Vietnam 20 su 1953, but Numista lists the 20 su (Bao Dai) as KM#2; KM#1 is the 10 su (hobbyofkings 3-coin set: 1/2/3 = 10/20/50). Verify denomination vs KM number.

C258.story: A 1953 20 su from Vietnam. The reverse shows three rice stalks tied with ribbon; VIET-NAM, 20 SU, three-dragon obverse with the date. Struck in aluminum.
